title: AgentSkillFrontmatter
description: Standardized YAML frontmatter schema for autonomous agent skills (SKILL.md).

name.description: Unique identifier slug for the skill (lowercase, alphanumeric with hyphens or underscores).

description.description: Detailed explanation of what the skill does and exact criteria for when the agent should load it.

disable-model-invocation.description: Set to true if this skill is strictly user-invoked and should not be loaded autonomously by the model.

category.description: Functional domain category (e.g. development, security, workflow, ai-ml, design).

domain.description: Higher-level universal knowledge domain (e.g. finance, healthcare, engineering, computer-science).

subdomain.description: Specialized sub-discipline within the domain (e.g. accounting, cardiology, structural-engineering).

author.description: Author, team, or upstream repository maintainer.

license.description: Software license for the skill instructions (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0).

risk.description: Security and operational risk classification of the skill.

level.description: Competency or difficulty level required to execute or understand this skill.

triggers.description: List of user phrases or prompt keywords that trigger the activation of this skill.

negative_triggers.description: Phrases or contexts that explicitly suppress or forbid this skill from activating.

aliases.description: Short command or slash command aliases for manual invocation (e.g. ['/test', 'run-tests']).

keywords.description: Search and retrieval indexing tokens for dynamic vector or BM25 retrieval.

tools.description: List of tool capabilities required by the agent to execute this skill.

platforms.description: Target AI agent host platforms officially supported by this skill.

mcp_servers.description: List of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers required (e.g. ['filesystem', 'github', 'fetch', 'memory']).

inputs.description: Input modalities accepted by the skill (e.g. ['text', 'code', 'image', 'audio', 'pdf']).

outputs.description: Output modalities produced by the skill (e.g. ['text', 'code', 'diagram', 'structured-data']).

jurisdiction.description: Geographic or legal jurisdictions where this skill applies (e.g. ['US', 'EU', 'Global', 'UK', 'Ethiopia']).

env.description: Environment variable names required at runtime (e.g. ['OPENAI_API_KEY', 'AWS_REGION']).

parameters.description: Optional argument schema accepted when invoking this skill directly.

preconditions.description: Checks that must pass before execution (e.g. ['git_clean', 'venv_active', 'tests_passing']).

postconditions.description: Checks that must pass after execution (e.g. ['syntax_valid', 'tests_pass', 'lint_clean']).

fallback_skill.description: Alternative skill ID to route to if this skill fails.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of corrective attempts before aborting.

on_failure.description: Action to take when failure threshold is reached.

recovery.description: Automated fallback and loop prevention strategy.
